coverage.note: The quarterly-earnings page exposes three PDF downloads per listed quarter: news release, presentation, and quarterly supplement. No PPTX, DOC/DOCX, XLS/XLSX, CSV, image, audio, or other non-PDF quarter files were linked on that page.
